note: Where a piece runs — Meta primary text, a subject line, a landing page. Separate from format: the same format can run in several placements.

rows.name: Primary text / caption
rows.what: The words above the creative in the feed.
rows.evidence: proven — copy machine `caption` row; 216 swiped examples in corpus

rows.name: Headline
rows.what: The bolded line under the creative — the ad's one claim.
rows.evidence: evidenced — 15 real AdPlexity titles in corpus ('Collagen creams can't absorb. This serum can.')

rows.name: Description
rows.what: The small line under the headline. Most people never read it.
rows.evidence: proven — copy machine defaults (2 at 3 words)

rows.name: Angle
rows.what: The copy block's framing — the bet a brand makes, carried by many creatives. Not an ad; the idea ads are cut from.
rows.evidence: evidenced — 223 swiped angles across four brands, ranked by heat

rows.name: Static / video overlay
rows.what: Words ON the creative — the message that survives sound-off.
rows.evidence: evidenced — 46 overlay sets extracted from teardowns; music-only sources carry the whole script this way

rows.name: Video ad script
rows.what: The spoken words of the ad, beat by beat.
rows.evidence: proven — the video-teardown chain end to end (hooks v11, close v6)

extra.carries_offer: in the close, exactly as the offer file words it

rows.name: Creator caption
rows.what: The post's own words under an organic video or image.
rows.evidence: evidenced — 360 real captions in corpus with views/likes signals

rows.name: Hook line / overlay
rows.what: The first-frame words — the two-second stop decision.
rows.evidence: proven — video-teardown 4b (entry test, four-word test, photograph test)

rows.name: Organic post (short / long)
rows.what: A story post with no offer — short-form and long-form per the machine's rows.
rows.evidence: proven — copy machine short-form + long-form rows

extra.carries_offer: never on organic; late and soft when repurposed paid

rows.name: Organic video script
rows.what: Spoken words for a native post — the ORGANIC lane's rebuild.
rows.evidence: proven — video-teardown ORGANIC lane (expansion stage gated in)

extra.carries_offer: one aside at most — the lane dies if it sells

rows.name: Campaign email
rows.what: A one-off send to a segment.
rows.evidence: proven — email machine; 309 shipped <brand> sends classified in corpus

extra.carries_offer: usually — but the treatment (story/proof/offer) is the concept brief's call

rows.name: Flow email
rows.what: A triggered send — welcome, abandon, post-purchase, winback.
rows.evidence: drafted — flow sends sit inside the <brand> scrape, not yet split out

extra.carries_offer: per flow position — never in the first welcome

rows.name: Subject + preview
rows.what: The open decision — two fragments doing one job.
rows.evidence: evidenced — 309 subject+preview pairs indexed in the send catalogue

extra.carries_offer: only when the offer IS the news

rows.name: Landing page / advertorial
rows.what: The click's destination — attention is spent, conviction is the job.
rows.evidence: evidenced — 47 swiped pages captured (incl. a 21,490px advertorial), 4 of ours

extra.carries_offer: yes, staged — price appears after the mechanism, never before

rows.name: Quiz
rows.what: Question-led conviction — the reader tells us the argument to make.
rows.evidence: proven — quiz-funnel skill + 1 shipped <brand> quiz; <competitor> runs quiz.<competitor>.com as its whole front door

rows.name: PDP
rows.what: The product's own page — where every funnel eventually lands.
rows.evidence: drafted — brand product files exist; no PDP spec has been exercised by a machine yet

extra.carries_offer: yes — the canonical price, never a channel-specific one
